sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com) pages Henry Legolant and Recombination Magic, read through search summaries only (host unreachable): the magic reshapes the magic house (rearranging rooms, humanoid and beast shapes); spells listed for him: Raging Black Bull, Mana Corkscrew, Mana Rocket Punch, The Mini Bull, Ultra Giant Bull.
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by search (pixiv encyclopedia, manga-tantei, manga-legend, namu): 組換魔法, 黒の暴牛号 in a two-legged battle form and a four-legged travel form, マナ・コークスクリュー, マナロケットパンチ, the hideout can be repaired and rebuilt by the same magic.
sources.repo_wiki: The fandom spell page Ultra Giant Bull (Compound Magic) cached in the repo (.github/wiki/spell_ultra_giant_bull.txt).
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs: see docs/magic/character_spells_bulls.md.

spells.name: Recombination Magic: Mana Corkscrew
spells.ja: マナ・コークスクリュー
spells.note: The hideout's fist turns as it punches. Mode 0 of the Recombination book, so it stays in the basic book too.

spells.name: Recombination Magic: Raging Black Bull
spells.note: The hideout becomes a giant bull. Already locked to his grimoire.

spells.name: Recombination Magic: Mana Rocket Punch
spells.note: NEW page: the bull's fist flies on mana.

spells.name: Recombination Magic: The Mini Bull
spells.note: NEW page: a small bull that charges. Only the name is known, so the effect is modest.

spells.name: Recombination Magic: Room Rebuild
spells.note: The hideout is repaired and rebuilt by the same magic after a battle.

spells.name: Recombination Magic: Room Swap
spells.note: Rearranging the rooms of the house.

spells.name: Compound Magic: Ultra Giant Bull
spells.note: The compound spell of four Black Bulls (Mirror multiplies the Transmutation user, who turns a structure into the house's material, Recombination builds the bull with a cockpit, Poison absorbs the enemy's magic through it).

notes: Not in Henry's grimoire (kept in the basic Recombination book, no source found): Bulwark, House Armour, Plank Snare.
